body.statement: Two disjoint nonempty convex subsets of a finite-dimensional real vector space, one compact and the other open, admit a separating nonzero affine functional; when the open set has the positive-orthant recession cone, the functional's linear coefficients may be taken nonnegative.

attestation.note: The immutable core supplied the book citation; the stable DOI is given because no lawful verbatim transcription was supplied.
